1981-2324-2415-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Proper Burial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1385-2301-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1385-2301-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat, Abzan Ascendancy and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1849-4770-5301-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

985-5078-7295-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4499-7818-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1636-5900-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures, three of which are Elves excluding Thranduil that do not have summoning sickness.
1636-5900-7892.description:
Activate three Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking a creature you control.
When the creature enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-5900-7892.notes: If you happen to control an Elf that has haste, you can perform the combo only controlling three Elves and blink the Elf with haste each loop. Otherwise, you can blink Thranduil or any other creature that isn't tapping for mana.

2590-5776-7175-7313.description:
Activate another creature you control, which is a Food due to Ygra, by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Ygra and Experimental Confectioner trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

147-413-7335.easyPrerequisites: There is a valid target for Pain 101 on the battlefield.
147-413-7335.description:
Cast Pain 101 by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Pain 101, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Pain 101.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities from step 7.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7233.easyPrerequisites: Instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard have total mana value 2 or greater.
2511-6972-7233.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Inferno Project.
When Inferno Project dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3875-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1270-3875-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create three token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating a Mutavault land token that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 4 for the second trigger.
Repeat from step 4 for the third trigger, instead choosing to pay for Springheart Nantuko's trigger to create three token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

1482-2866-4659-4986.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2498-2541-4017.description:
Activate Benthic Biomancer by paying {1}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2541-2919-4869.notablePrerequisites:
Glint-Horn Buccaneer has lifelink.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
2541-2919-4869.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

2593-4331-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six artifacts.
2593-4331-6747.description:
Cast Astral Cornucopia, choosing for X to equal at least {2}, but paying {0} due to Sami. Astral Cornucopia will enter with at least two charge counters on it.
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Drafna by paying {1}{U}, returning Astral Cornucopia from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2593-4331-6747.notes: If you wish to get infinite mana, you must control nine or more artifacts.

338-1818-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1818-4186.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2919-3197-4268.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3197-4268.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3525-4474-6210.description:
Activate Neerdiv by tapping it, adding {U}.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Neerdiv.
Repeat.

1563-2457-3129-4927.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

4050-4775-6553.easyPrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
4050-4775-6553.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Repeat.

2752-3469-5261.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {5}{G}.
Elder Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Energy Arc exiled by Isochron Scepter.
2752-3469-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Elder Druid by paying {3}{G} and tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

914-3036-4885.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3036-4885.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

930-3781-4973-5231.description:
Cast Universal Automaton from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {1}.
When Universal Automaton dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast Universal Automaton from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Resolve the Zask trigger, causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 2.

323-5544-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
323-5544-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, targeting an opponent.
Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble ability, causing you to gain 1 life and causing an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3693-4613-5616.notablePrerequisites: Strong has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3693-4613-5616.description:
Activate Strong using Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to Strong.
Strong triggers, putting three +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to get three rad counters.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Strong using Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 4 as desired.

891-2523-2921-5515.easyPrerequisites: On Serra's Wings attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-2523-2921-5515.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies as a legendary creature due to On Serra's Wings, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Boonweaver Giant that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning On Serra's Wings from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3129-3398-4076.notablePrerequisites:
You have a full party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos and Hellkite Charger.
3129-3398-4076.description:
Declare Burakos and Hellkite Charger as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Burakos trigger, creating eight Treasure artifact tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose 4 life.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2290-4613-5292.notablePrerequisites: Voice of the Blessed has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2290-4613-5292.description:
Activate Voice of the Blessed using Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain 2 life.
Voice of the Blessed triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat.

141-4799.description:
Cast Necromantic Selection by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Necromantic Selection.
Resolve the copy of Necromantic Selection, destroying all creatures and returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

215-2397-4022.description:
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hidden Herbalists to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying {1}{G}.
When Hidden Herbalists enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

618-914-4896.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
618-914-4896.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasures.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}{U}.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasures, you may instead create token copies of any other nonlegendary creature you control.

1872-3003-5105.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five artifacts.
1872-3003-5105.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Composite Golem from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Composite Golem from your hand by paying at most {2}.
Repeat.

1606-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Ley Weaver.
You control two lands that can produce a total of {1}{U} or more.
Ley Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
1606-4222.description:
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping two lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.
